title: Travel & Tourism - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Travel & Tourism market is projected to reach US$491.51bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 4.16%, resulting in a projected market volume of US$602.51bn by 2031.
The largest Travel & Tourism market is the Hotels market with a projected market volume of US$372.06bn in 2026.
In the Hotels market, the number of users is expected to amount to 1.13bn users by 2031.
The average revenue per user (ARPU) is expected to amount to US$400.97.
